scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: Compute the selector component occupied-cell count modulo the total component count; this is a nonzero left-rotation offset.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the unique nonzero 4-connected component whose bounding box touches an input border.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Sort all components by occupied-cell count descending, rotate that sequence left by the computed offset, then pack same-color bars with one zero separator.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The first output bar and every subsequent bar position depend on the offset produced from the border selector; before identifying and measuring that component, the rotated order cannot be chosen.

This is authoring preflight evidence, not owner acceptance or training admission.
